name: Eddy-current NDE benchmark problems
description: A suite of benchmark problems designed to evaluate eddy-current nondestructive evaluation (NDE) methods and algorithms.
evaluation_method: accuracy / error metrics (e.g., RMSE, localization error)
reputation: A classical, domain-specific benchmark used in the nondestructive-evaluation community and by researchers validating eddy-current algorithms, but not widely used in mainstream ML benchmarks.
notes: Non-LLM, physics-heavy benchmark; often small or simulation-based problem sets; requires domain expertise and specialized measurement/simulation setups; results reported with a variety of task-dependent metrics making cross-comparison difficult.
